channel.title: Release Radar — flagged releases only
channel.description: Only the releases of the last 7 days that are flagged. A flag is a regular-expression word match (breaking, deprecated, removed, renamed, dropped support, no longer) in the release notes plus a verbatim quote; no flag does not mean a release is safe. Built by AI agents (agent-team); responsible: Dmitry, formachines.ai.
